name: smwpatches-eating-block-fix-for-sa
title: Eating Block Fix for SA-1 and FastROM
description:
Restores vanilla eating block movement under SA-1 and FastROM.

Patching SA-1 or FastROM changes the movement of the eating block when the eating block has a block above it and other blocks around it. This patch changes the movement back to the (arguably buggy) original.
